The unit features two large circular speaker drivers on the left and right sides, flanking a vertical interface strip containing buttons and a small display. The enclosure appears to be made of plastic with a matte finish.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The symbols and text on the buttons and display are indistinct and slightly melted, lacking the sharp edges of real printed electronics labels.
The mesh pattern on the left and right drivers is inconsistent and slightly blurry, lacking the precise geometric regularity of a manufactured grille.
Slight waviness in the straight horizontal line of the top casing, suggesting minor generation instability.

focus_areas: Legibility of text/icons on the central control strip
Symmetry and geometric precision of the circular speaker drivers
Sharpness of the boundary between the silver interface and black casing
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the central control panel. AI models often struggle with rendering small, functional text and icons on electronics. If the text auditor finds illegible glyphs, this is a strong artifact signal. Also, verify if the 'speakers' are actually just painted circles or if they have depth/texture consistent with real hardware.
